Headline: Ghana ID Crackdown: Digital Verification Now Mandatory

Summary:
In response to widespread fraud, Ghana has made digital identity checks compulsory and banned photocopied IDs. This shift aims to tighten verification across government, banking, and other services.

Key points:
- Digital verification is now mandatory; physical copies no longer accepted
- Aimed at curbing identity fraud and improving data integrity
- Affects banking, public services, and licensed transactions
- Individuals should update records via accredited centers and verify official channels

Action items:
- Update your ID through accredited registration centers
- Carry only the original document when transacting
- Check official sources for updated procedures and list of accredited centers

Why this matters:
- Reduces impersonation and document forgery
- Supports secure digital governance
- Streamlines service delivery

Risks of non-compliance:
- Service denial at banks, government offices, and license issuers
- Potential penalties for using invalid documents

How to prepare:
- Visit a recognized enrollment center to renew or replace your ID
- Ensure your biometrics and records are current
- Share updates only through verified platforms

Note: For latest guidance, follow official announcements from Ghana’s identity authorities and trusted news outlets.

Kesalahpahaman Saat Antre BBM di SPBU Radamata Berakhir Damai Melalui Mediasi Polisi 

Sebuah kesalahpahaman yang terjadi saat antrean pengisian bahan bakar minyak (BBM) di SPBU Radamata, Desa Radamata, Kecamatan Kota Tambolaka, Kabupaten Sumba Barat Daya, pada Rabu (15/7/2026) sekitar pukul 11.30 Wita, berhasil diselesaikan secara damai melalui mediasi yang difasilitasi oleh pihak kepolisian.

Peristiwa bermula ketika seorang perempuan berinisial M.M. (39) sedang mengantre untuk mengisi BBM.

Saat proses antrean berlangsung, perempuan berinisial P.L. (38) datang dan diduga masuk ke barisan depan tanpa mengikuti antrean. Teguran yang disampaikan memicu adu mulut antara keduanya.

Situasi kemudian memanas setelah terjadi saling dorong terhadap kendaraan yang sedang mengantre. Perselisihan berlanjut hingga terjadi aksi saling pukul yang mengakibatkan kedua belah pihak mengalami luka ringan.

Usai kejadian, kedua pihak mendatangi Sentra Pelayanan Kepolisian Terpadu (SPKT) Polres Sumba Barat Daya untuk melaporkan peristiwa tersebut.
